The actual source dispatcher is a typed direct host API with a reusable incremental cursor. Automatic moved-missile per-body Evolve/FFI scheduling must call this same implementation at the source publication boundary; it is not wired yet.

Generation/entity/world identity guards cancel stale owners and reject foreign cursors; shrinking below captured count reports an error after prior effects. These are explicit safe Rust responses to unsafe/dangling original cases, not portable source-equivalence claims.
Actual PyOS/PyError unwinding behavior, pending work snapshots, complete controller/callback interactions, source/configuration closure and mandatory proofs remain open.

The public cursor is bound to the active engine object. Defined Original retained/detached owner dispatch is a required open lifetime mapping; not every removal/replacement case is classified as unsafe.
Current metadata/logical snapshots have no source mOldPos/mOldVel owner. Immutable PreparedMotion cannot retain mutations to a later body pending result during a previous callback.

New AddBall initializes old position as current position minus dt times velocity, while replacement retains old vectors. Command setters write both vector slots; publication swaps them. All these phases and fields need generated state, runtime reachability and independent evidence.
Full old/new interpolation, mutation ordering, pending snapshots, dynamic orientation and source/configuration/proof gates remain open.
